breakouts.h: Breakout watch: 12 players ready to make the leap
breakouts.d: Rating jumps from offseason training, new starting jobs, scheme fits and what they did with limited snaps last year. These are the names to know before kickoff.

list.name: C.Scruggs
list.d: [[p:557726090|C.Scruggs]] saw his pass blocking (74 to 92) and power pass protection (75 to 93) take a big step in training. Add this: he came out of the offseason at 84 overall, up from 76. Plus, he is penciled in as a starter for the first time. Clemson fans are about to get a new favorite player.

list.name: M.O'Dell
list.d: [[p:557714455|M.O'Dell]] came out of the offseason at 80 overall, up from 67. Add this: he saw his hands (74 to 89) and spectacular-catch ability (70 to 85) take a big step in training. Plus, he slides into the starting lineup with D.Overby, B.McLane and J.Smith gone. By October, everyone will know it.

list.name: J.Henderson
list.d: [[p:557724784|J.Henderson]] came out of the offseason at 86 overall, up from 76. On top of that, he saw his hands (67 to 77) and catching in traffic (57 to 67) take a big step in training. And he slides into the starting lineup with M.Danzy and Z.Ragins gone. Circle his name now.

list.name: P.Carver
list.d: [[p:557720529|P.Carver]] jumped from 63 to 78 overall this offseason. Better yet, he saw his release off the line (74 to 86) and short route running (62 to 74) take a big step in training. And he slides into the starting lineup with L.Watkins and L.Seib gone. This is the year.

list.name: R.Burks
list.d: [[p:557721069|R.Burks]] jumped from 65 to 77 overall this offseason. Also: he saw his short accuracy (80 to 90) and mid-range accuracy (66 to 76) take a big step in training. And he slides into the starting lineup with J.Kohl gone. By October, everyone will know it.

list.name: S.Emanuel
list.d: [[p:557721415|S.Emanuel]] came out of the offseason at 82 overall, up from 69. Add this: he saw his hands (66 to 79) and spectacular-catch ability (86 to 99) take a big step in training. And he slides into the starting lineup with R.Niblett and J.Bishop Jr. gone. Circle his name now.

list.name: T.Crethers
list.d: [[p:557727223|T.Crethers]] jumped from 74 to 86 overall this offseason. Better yet, he slides into the starting lineup with J.Cooper and J.Hale gone. And he saw his hands (68 to 73) and catching in traffic (62 to 67) take a big step in training. By October, everyone will know it.

list.name: T.Coutee
list.d: [[p:557717616|T.Coutee]] saw his zone coverage (50 to 71) and play recognition (49 to 67) take a big step in training. Add this: he came out of the offseason at 75 overall, up from 63. And he brings a bump and run skill set to a scheme that ranks 6th in defensive pass yards per game. Buffalo fans are about to get a new favorite player.
